name: Build & Test

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: 'Branch or tag ref to check out'
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ''
      artifact_name:
        description: 'Name of the artifact to upload'
        type: string
        required: false
        default: 'npm-package'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build_test:
    name: Build & Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10 # v6.0.3
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || '' }}
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@0e279bb959325dab635dd2c09392533439d90093 # v6.0.8
        with:
          run_install: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: 'package.json'
          # Builds from main and release tags are published or used as a baseline,
          # so only pull request builds may use cached dependencies.
          cache: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'pnpm' || '' }}
          # Prevent automatic caching when the explicit cache input is empty.
          package-manager-cache: false
          cache-dependency-path: pnpm-lock.yaml
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run build
      - name: Package
        # Package and upload the build before any test or reporting tooling
        # runs, without running pack lifecycle scripts.
        run: |
          pnpm pack --config.ignore-scripts=true
          mv preact-*.tgz preact.tgz
      - name: Upload npm package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact_name || 'npm-package' }}
          path: preact.tgz
      - name: test
        env:
          CI: true
          COVERAGE: true
          FLAKEY: false
        run: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:unit
      - name: Coveralls GitHub Action
        # The reporter binary is downloaded at runtime: keep it out of release builds.
        if: ${{ github.ref_type != 'tag' }}
        uses: coverallsapp/github-action@5cbfd81b66ca5d10c19b062c04de0199c215fb6e # v2.3.7
        timeout-minutes: 2
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          coverage-reporter-version: v0.6.22
          fail-on-error: false

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
